title: Uncaught DB Validation Errors
body:
### Search first

- [x] I searched and no similar issues were found

### What Happened?

After https://github.com/logseq/db-test/issues/518 was fixed, I was able to import the exported EDN, but it still created an invalid graph. I don't have the time to help test this further, but I was able to easily manually fix the three errors with the help of Claude Code. I then had Claude Code write up a full report. Since I have already fixed these errors manually, I can't test it again, but hopefully this report can help the team improve the validation command. 

## Executive Summary

The Logseq DB export validation tool failed to catch three distinct data corruption issues that caused the "invalid DB" error during import. All three issues involved malformed property values that should have been detected and either fixed or flagged during the export process.

### Key Log Messages

```
:frontend.db.restore/restore-graph! loads 20239 datoms in 237 ms
db restored, setting up repo hooks
```

Then immediately:

```
"Invalid datascript entities detected amongst changed entity ids:"
(7986 8243 4926 8374 2829 10347 ...)  [large list of entity IDs]
```

Final error:

```
Error: DB write failed with invalid data
    at new En (/js/db-worker.js?electron=false&publishing=false:714:26)
```

---

## Issue #1: Empty Placeholder Keywords in Property Values

### Description
The `:logseq.property/empty-placeholder` keyword was used as an actual property value instead of being replaced with a proper value or removed during export validation.

### Entity Details

**Entity UUID:** `684234b9-42eb-48db-b003-46acf32a9767`

**Location in Graph:**
- Journal page: May 30, 2025 (`:build/journal 20250530`)
- Parent: Task block within "Personal Log" section → "📥 Inbox" → Task with parent project reference
- Block title: "Data"
- Created: 1749169337693 (Feb 5, 2025)
- Updated: 1749169375685 (Feb 5, 2025)

**Problematic Property Structure in Export:**

```clojure
{:block/title "Data",
 :block/uuid #uuid "684234b9-42eb-48db-b003-46acf32a9767",
 :build/keep-uuid? true,
 :block/created-at 1749169337693,
 :block/updated-at 1749169375685,
 :build/properties
 {:logseq.property/background-color
  :logseq.property/empty-placeholder},  ; ← INVALID: keyword instead of value
 :build/children [...]}
```

**Validation Error from Log:**

```
{:entity-map
 {:block/tx-id 536870915,
  :block/uuid #uuid "684234b9-42eb-48db-b003-46acf32a9767",
  :block/properties
  ([:logseq.property/background-color 3438]  ; references invalid entity
   [:logseq.property/created-by-ref 158]),
  :block/title "Data",
  :db/id 397,
  :block/parent 3415,
  :block/order "cSW2",
  :block/page 392},
 :errors
 [{:block/properties
   [["should be a text block" "should be a text block"]]}]}
```

**Expected Behavior:**
- Export validation should detect `:logseq.property/empty-placeholder` as invalid
- Should either remove the property or replace with valid default value
- Should warn user about incomplete data

**Actual Behavior:**
- Export completed without warnings
- Invalid placeholder keyword exported as property value
- Import validation caught the error, but too late

---

## Issue #2: Duplicate Empty Placeholder (Same Pattern)

### Entity Details

**Entity UUID:** `335c5c5a-04d3-4289-904a-9c2302046a68`

**Location in Graph:**
- Journal page: July 8, 2025 (`:build/journal 20250708`)
- Parent: Block referencing page "book biographies" (`686c552b-20d8-4e95-9f3d-fe51b4e4c871`)
- Block title: "[redacted]"
- Tags: `:user.class/ck-LlNebFGj` (custom user tag)
- Created: 1751930167529 (July 7, 2025)
- Updated: 1751930207614 (July 7, 2025)

**Problematic Property Structure in Export:**

```clojure
{:block/title
 "[redacted]",
 :block/uuid #uuid "335c5c5a-04d3-4289-904a-9c2302046a68",
 :block/created-at 1751930167529,
 :block/updated-at 1751930207614,
 :build/tags [:user.class/ck-LlNebFGj],
 :build/properties
 {:logseq.property/background-color
  :logseq.property/empty-placeholder}}  ; ← SAME INVALID PATTERN
```

**Validation Error from Log:**

```clojure
{:entity-map
 {:block/tx-id 536870915,
  :block/uuid #uuid "335c5c5a-04d3-4289-904a-9c2302046a68",
  :block/properties
  ([:logseq.property/background-color 4819]
   [:logseq.property/created-by-ref 158]),
  :block/title
  "[redacted]",
  :db/id 4820,
  :block/parent 4818,
  :block/order "cSt2",
  :block/page 289},
 :errors
 [{:block/properties
   [["should be a text block" "should be a text block"]]}]}
```

**Pattern Recognition:**
This is the **exact same issue** as #1, demonstrating that the validation tool systematically failed to catch this pattern across multiple entities.

---

## Issue #3: Nested Property Values Missing Required Attributes

### Description
A property value was stored as a nested `:build/property-value :block` entity, but this entity was missing required database attributes (`block/parent`, `block/order`, `block/page`), making it invalid when referenced as a standalone entity.

### Entity Details

**Entity UUID:** `6863e5cd-b938-4341-884b-f2bb9091de23`

**Location in Graph:**
- Page: "[redacted]" (contact page, UUID: `681fd44c-e43c-4b8e-b034-cea4af3494a2`)
- Property: `:user.property/Phone-NEcdSnDp` (Phone property)
- Property value contains nested block entity
- Created: 1751377357872 (June 28, 2025)
- Updated: 1751377359598 (June 28, 2025)

**Problematic Structure in Export:**

```clojure
{:block/title "[redacted]",
 :block/uuid #uuid "681fd44c-e43c-4b8e-b034-cea4af3494a2",
 :build/tags [:user.class/contact-ESRBhYwz],
 :build/properties
 {:user.property/NUM-2ndPhone-nYi3PCWG "[redacted]",
  :user.property/Phone-NEcdSnDp
  {:build/property-value :block,  ; ← Nested block as property value
   :block/title "[redacted]",
   :build/tags [:user.class/quickreference-B4L1vhIX],
   :block/uuid #uuid "6863e5cd-b938-4341-884b-f2bb9091de23",
   :build/keep-uuid? true,
   :block/created-at 1751377357872,
   :block/updated-at 1751377359598}},  ; ← MISSING: block/parent, block/order, block/page
 ...}
```

**Reference to This Entity:**

The entity was also referenced by an "Unlinked references" view:

```clojure
{:block/title "Unlinked references",
 :block/created-at 1752309687983,
 :block/updated-at 1752309688017,
 :build/properties
 {:logseq.property.view/type :logseq.property.view/type.list,
  :logseq.property.view/group-by-property :block/page,
  :logseq.property.view/feature-type :unlinked-references,
  :logseq.property/view-for
  [:block/uuid #uuid "6863e5cd-b938-4341-884b-f2bb9091de23"]}}
  ; ← References the incomplete entity as if it's a full page
```

**Validation Error from Log:**

```clojure
{:entity-map
 {:block/tx-id 536870915,
  :block/uuid #uuid "6863e5cd-b938-4341-884b-f2bb9091de23",
  :block/properties ([:logseq.property/created-by-ref 158]),
  :db/id 1018},
 :errors
 [{:block/title ["missing required key" "missing required key"],
   :block/parent ["missing required key" "missing required key"],
   :block/order ["missing required key"],
   :block/page ["missing required key" "missing required key"],
   :block/created-at ["missing required key" "missing required key"],
   :block/updated-at ["missing required key" "missing required key"]}]}
```

**Root Cause Analysis:**

1. The phone number was stored as a **nested block entity** (`:build/property-value :block`) within the property value
2. This nested entity has its own UUID and is treated as a referenceable entity
3. An "Unlinked references" view references this UUID as if it's a full page
4. However, the entity lacks required attributes for a standalone block:
   - `:block/parent` - which block is its parent
   - `:block/order` - ordering among siblings
   - `:block/page` - which page it belongs to
5. When imported, the database cannot resolve this entity properly

**Expected Behavior:**

Either:
- **Option A:** Nested property-value blocks should be fully validated with all required attributes before export
- **Option B:** Property values should be simplified to plain text during export (e.g., just store "[redacted]" as a string)
- **Option C:** Export validation should detect entities referenced by views but lacking required attributes

**Actual Behavior:**
- Export completed without validation errors
- Incomplete nested entity exported
- Import validation caught the missing required keys

---

## Additional Entities Created During Import

The import process generated **additional invalid entities** when trying to handle the empty-placeholder values:

**Generated UUID 1:** `69022609-73cf-4a48-a237-16f710270648`
**Generated UUID 2:** `69022609-93bd-45aa-89fb-cdc004859f37`

These entities **do not exist** in the original EDN export file. They were created during the import process, likely as Logseq attempted to resolve the `:logseq.property/empty-placeholder` keywords into actual entities.

**Validation errors for generated entity 1:**

```clojure
{:entity-map
 {:block/tx-id 536870915,
  :block/uuid #uuid "69022609-73cf-4a48-a237-16f710270648",
  :block/properties ([:logseq.property/created-by-ref 158]),
  :block/updated-at 1761748489697,
  :block/created-at 1761748489697,
  :block/title :logseq.property/empty-placeholder,  ; ← Title is keyword!
  :logseq.property/created-from-property 48,
  :db/id 3438,
  :block/parent 397,
  :block/order "cSW3",
  :block/page 392},
 :errors [{:block/title ["should be a string" "should be a string"]}]}
```

This demonstrates that the import process tried to **auto-create entities** from the placeholder keywords but created invalid entities with keyword titles instead of strings.

---

## Impact Analysis

### Total Entities Affected
- **Direct errors:** 3 entities with malformed data
- **Generated errors:** 2+ entities created during import attempt
- **Total validation failures:** 700+ entity IDs flagged in log

### Cascade Effect

The three source errors cascaded into hundreds of validation failures because:

1. The incomplete entity (phone number) was referenced by views
2. The empty-placeholder keywords were resolved into new entities during import
3. These new entities triggered additional validation failures
4. The entire import transaction was rolled back

---

## Recommendations for Logseq Development Team

### 1. Pre-Export Validation (High Priority)

Implement comprehensive validation **before** writing the EDN file:

```clojure
; Pseudocode for validation checks
(defn validate-export [db]
  (let [entities (get-all-entities db)]
    (doseq [entity entities]
      ;; Check 1: Validate property values
      (validate-properties entity)

      ;; Check 2: Validate entity completeness
      (validate-required-attributes entity)

      ;; Check 3: Validate references
      (validate-references entity db))))

(defn validate-properties [entity]
  (doseq [[prop-key prop-val] (:properties entity)]
    (when (= prop-val :logseq.property/empty-placeholder)
      (warn-or-fix entity prop-key))
    (when (keyword? prop-val)
      (validate-keyword-as-value prop-val))
    (when (map? prop-val)
      (validate-nested-entity prop-val))))
```
